request: Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Furnace Scarab". Creative brief: Collection: Ashforge Remnants. Core concept: A rotating artillery unit that vents sparks from different shell openings. Body and silhouette: Wide mechanical beetle with a domed shell, six blunt legs, and a low armored head. Signature features: Four vent holes, riveted shell bands, and a glowing underside. Palette and materials: Dark steel, oxidized copper, furnace orange, and soot brown. Movement personality: Slow, weighty, and rhythmically mechanical. Attack concept: Locks in place and fires from each vent clockwise, producing four clearly timed lines of sparks. Directional details: The rear-left vent is clogged and releases smoke instead of a projectile. Avoid: Sleek technology, realistic beetle legs, tiny indistinguishable rivets.
